comment: FeatureBoundaryTests (artifacts/restructure-plan/backend.md §7.2). allow: Features.<A> types may reference Features.<B> for each B listed under A ("*" = any). Controllers may reference only their own feature plus Shared/Infrastructure/Configuration/Transport/Logger, whatever this list says. enforced: features whose violations fail the test; each Phase 2 step adds its feature, S3 makes it every feature. Until then the test is report-only. A new edge needs an edit to this file in the same PR.
